project_goal: A tool that helps users plan trips by collecting their food preferences, destination, and travel timing, then outputs dining recommendations, essential travel advisories, and a travel friendliness score for comparison.

database.notes: Needs to store user preferences (food likes/dislikes, dietary restrictions), destination data (country, city), seasonal/monthly metadata, and output content (dining places/dishes, advisories, scores).

api.notes: Likely requires external APIs for weather forecasts, news headlines, and possibly restaurant/place data. May need internal API to calculate travel friendliness score and compare destinations.

app_ui.notes: Input section collects user preferences, destination, and time; output section displays three distinct blocks: dining recommendations, essential advisories, and travel friendliness score with comparison.
app_ui.layout_structure: Two main sections: top half for user input (divided into Preference, Where I am going, When, Compare where I’m going with), bottom half for Output (three side-by-side boxes).
ui_components: Dropdown or select for optional city
Radio or checkbox for food preferences
Text input or selector for season/month
Three output panels: Dining Recommendation, Essential Travel Advisory, Travel Friendliness

ai_reporter.notes: May be used to generate personalized dining recommendations and calculate the travel friendliness score based on inputs and external data.

deployment.notes: No deployment details visible. Assumed to be web-based given dashboard nature.
